secondaryExteriorValidation.title: Feline Skeletal System - Thorax & Abdomen
secondaryExteriorValidation.declaredSource: 3D anatomical reconstruction of an 11-year-old male cat segmented from a 1,573-slice CT scan at 0.6 mm and 512 by 512 resolution
secondaryExteriorValidation.role: independent soft-tissue envelope and skeleton-to-skin relationship check only
secondaryExteriorValidation.reasonNotPrimary: weaker institutional and license traceability than the selected University of Edinburgh reference

selectionRationale.decision: The University of Edinburgh model is the primary whole-body structural reference.
why: The model has direct veterinary-school provenance.
The geometry is described as CT-derived.
The source page provides named contributors and an attribution license.
The model covers the full domestic-cat skeleton at substantially higher resolution than generic game or robotics meshes.
selectionRationale.boundary: The selected model establishes structural anatomy. Living exterior, muscles, fascia, paw pads, pinna soft tissue and coat still require separate evidence and region-level reconstruction.
